original_request: فأنا بقى عايز بقى مهارة تعمل الكلام ده ويعايز مهارة، ولو في مهارات بنفس الطريقة برضه ممكن أستعين بيها.
goal: Add the previously reviewed general visual asset discovery and integration workflow to GIS Development Skills.

target.deliverable: Repository specialist, routing, bilingual guides, local preparation helper and verified publication

desired_outcomes: Agents can route project imagery and official logo requests to a general specialist.
Agents have practical source, preparation and integration instructions plus related skill references.
success_criteria: Published specialist and routes match the reviewed visual-assets scope and pass repository checks.
assumptions: The current request authorizes implementing the discussed scope in the project repository; no other application is modified.
Existing permission to update this repository's main branch persists; no paid provider, dependency installation or sensitive upload is required.

tasks.title: Implement and publish visual asset specialist
tasks.description: Implement the discussed general scope, related source/skill references, preparation helper, routing and bilingual discovery; validate and publish the repository update.
acceptance_criteria: General image, thumbnail, official-logo, screenshot and illustration workflow has real-tool, provenance and factual-preview boundaries.
Main and lexical routers, platform handoffs, bilingual guides, homepage, Explorer and derived inventory expose the specialist.
Related image sources and skills are reviewed and their optional runtime/license limits are documented.
Local raster helper and repository validators pass with fresh behavior-test and output readback evidence.
Repository publication is independently read back at the new branch head.
